_meta.purpose: TEMPLATE. The medications you currently take. PERSONAL — you fill it in yourself. The single point of truth for interaction and drug-class checks.
_meta.how_to_fill: Through the application («Prescriptions» tab) or by hand. Adding a drug with a name already present updates that record rather than creating a duplicate.
_meta.why_empty: This file ships EMPTY on purpose: a sample prescription left in here would be counted in the header and checked for interactions as though you were taking it.
